title: CloudWatch observations
summary: CloudWatch provides metrics, logs and alarms for supported resources. A metric is a number over time; an alarm checks a condition.
introduction: CloudWatch provides metrics, logs and alarms for supported resources. A metric is a number over time; an alarm checks a condition. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: CloudWatch provides metrics, logs and alarms for supported resources. A metric is a number over time; an alarm checks a condition.

blocks.code:
Metric: request errors per minute
Alarm condition: errors exceed the chosen threshold
Response plan: inspect logs and recent changes
blocks.title: CloudWatch observations

blocks.text: The alarm points to a problem to investigate. It does not explain the cause by itself.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a non-secret log line for a failed page request.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not collect unnecessary personal data in logs.
